name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.mem_levU_one
source: theorem mem_levU_one {k Ω : Type} [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] {γ : G k Ω}
(h : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) - 1) : γ ∈ levU l (⊤ : Subgroup (G k Ω)) 1 := by
show PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) = 1
rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_one (PadicInt.toZModPow (p := l) 1), ← map_sub, ← RingHom.mem_ker, PadicInt.ker_toZModPow,
assume: Assume `(l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) - 1` (h).
show: Fix a prime ℓ and an algebraic closure Ω of a number field k. If γ ∈ Gal(Ω/k) satisfies ℓ ∣ χℓ(γ) − 1 in ℤℓ, then γ lies in the level-one subgroup levU(ℓ,Gal(Ω/k),1), the kernel of the cyclotomic character reduced modulo ℓ.
strategy: Test the cyclotomic unit after reduction modulo ℓ.

steps.claim: Every γ belongs to the full Galois group, so level-one membership reduces to showing that its cyclotomic unit maps to the identity under reduction. Two units are equal when their underlying ring elements agree.
steps.snippet:
(h : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) - 1) : γ ∈ levU l (⊤ : Subgroup (G k Ω)) 1 := by
  refine ⟨trivial, MonoidHom.mem_ker.2 (Units.ext ?_)⟩

steps.claim: The required equality in ℤ/ℓℤ says that the residue of the ℓ-adic integer underlying χℓ(γ) is 1, because unit reduction acts on underlying elements by the residue map.
steps.snippet: show PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) = 1
steps.typedFact: PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) = 1

steps.claim: Reduction preserves one and subtraction, so the residue is 1 precisely when χℓ(γ) − 1 lies in the kernel. This kernel is the principal ideal (ℓ), and the assumed divisibility places the difference in that ideal.
steps.snippet:
rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_one (PadicInt.toZModPow (p := l) 1), ← map_sub, ← RingHom.mem_ker, PadicInt.ker_toZModPow,
    pow_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact h

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
